adjudication.depicted_input: Instruction-example prompt box showing a structured biological text prompt supplied to the model.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is invalid because it shows downstream graders/scorers, not the target model input. A better source exists in figure 6: the instruction-example panel visibly contains the prompt text box that serves as the model-facing input interface. Cropping to that prompt portion isolates the route-relevant text prompt representation, which is the closest defensible depiction of the paper’s stated actual input for this evaluation route.
